authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3696 kṣīra explicitly gives Oriya khira and northern chīr milk. These forms fit the milk family; survey ṣīr requires distinguishing Iranian šīr or a demonstrated local change. Exact survey form cir is preserved; uncertain intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
